title: My random collection of pictures from nature and beyond.
text:
When you spend most of the time submerged in abstraction,







it is important to do something down to earth.









Baking bread.







View from Chata Socjologa in Bieszczady Mountains.

title: Jan Galek
text:
Hi! My name is Jan. This September I completed MSc in Mathematics and Foundations of Computer Science at the University of Oxford. Before I obtained my BSc in Mathematics and Philosophy at the University of Warwick.
I am primarily interested in the mathematical foundations of programming language semantics, particularly how we formalise and reason about program behaviour. My brief academic profile includes the following.


Theoretical computer science

denotational semantics
\(\lambda\)-calculus
type theory
formal verification

Mathematics

mathematical logic
category theory
general topology



Take a look on my projects site to see more!

title: Projects
text:
Dissertation
My master’s dissertation concerns contextual equivalence in simply typed lambda calculi: when can two terms be considered indistinguishable by the observations available to surrounding programs? You can read it here (PDF).
